The main takeaway from our work is that
the flow labeling scheme is asymptotically optimal, and that connectivity labeling is not necessarily easier than flow labeling.
, for flow and connectivity, labeling schemes can be designed with a number of labels that is within a constant factor of the information-theoretic lower bound.
